_readme: Site photo gallery on the projects page. Every item comes from the client's media batches 1 and 2 (numbers as in docs/photo-triage.xlsx) and is rated A or B, with no camera stamps and no third-party branding. Police or military sites are excluded, except photos 9, 34 and 43 (October New police district): the client confirmed the authority cleared publishing (answers batch 4, 2026-09-17), and they are cropped to keep police signage and the marked vehicles out of frame. Faces appear only where the client confirmed publishing permission (client answers batch 2, 2026-09-16). "alt" describes what is visible only — never a project name. "project" holds the project number from projects-inventory.xlsx once the client has confirmed which project a photo shows; only then may that project's photos appear on its card. Batch 1 is still unattributed (empty). Photos 198 and 200 come from the client's media batch 2 (2026-09-18), which was sent for project 30: the best three photos of that batch are on the project 30 card (projects.json "photos"), and no photo is both on a card and in the gallery.
